! =====================================================================
! Script Cisco IOS - Switch Principal L2 (SW-AnaFashion - 2960-24TT)
! Projeto: SmartRetail Network (Ana Fashion) - UniFECAF
! Passo 5: VLANs, Portas Access/Trunk, Hardening e SVI de Gerencia
! =====================================================================

enable
configure terminal

! --- 1. Identificacao e Seguranca Basica ---
hostname SW-AnaFashion
no ip domain-lookup
enable secret AnaFashion2026
service password-encryption
banner motd # Acesso Restrito - Ana Fashion (SW-AnaFashion) #

line console 0
 password ConAna2026
 login
 logging synchronous
 exit

line vty 0 15
 password VtyAna2026
 login
 exit

! --- 2. Criacao das VLANs (conforme plano_rede.md) ---
vlan 10
 name VENDAS_PDV
 exit
vlan 20
 name SERVIDORES
 exit
vlan 30
 name CFTV
 exit
vlan 40
 name WLAN_MOVEL
 exit
vlan 99
 name NATIVA_GERENCIA
 exit

! --- 3. Portas Access por Setor ---
! VLAN 10: Caixa-01 (Fa0/1), Caixa-02 (Fa0/2), Caixa-03 (Fa0/3), Impressora-Rede (Fa0/4)
interface range FastEthernet0/1 - 4
 description VLAN10_VENDAS_PDV
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10
 spanning-tree portfast
 no shutdown
 exit

! VLAN 20: SRV-Estoque-NVR (Fa0/9)
interface FastEthernet0/9
 description VLAN20_SRV_ESTOQUE_NVR
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 20
 spanning-tree portfast
 no shutdown
 exit

! VLAN 30: CAM-IP-01 a CAM-IP-04 (Fa0/11 a Fa0/14)
interface range FastEthernet0/11 - 14
 description VLAN30_CFTV_CAMERAS
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 30
 spanning-tree portfast
 no shutdown
 exit

! VLAN 40: AP-Loja (Fa0/19)
interface FastEthernet0/19
 description VLAN40_AP_LOJA
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 40
 spanning-tree portfast
 no shutdown
 exit

! --- 4. Porta Trunk 802.1Q para o Roteador (RTR-AnaFashion Gi0/0) ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description TRUNK_RTR_ANAFASHION
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk native vlan 99
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,40,99
 no shutdown
 exit

! --- 5. Hardening: Portas Ociosas / Reserva na VLAN 99 e Desligadas ---
interface range FastEthernet0/5 - 8
 description RESERVA_PDV_INATIVA
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 99
 shutdown
 exit

interface FastEthernet0/10
 description RESERVA_SRV_INATIVA
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 99
 shutdown
 exit

interface range FastEthernet0/15 - 18
 description RESERVA_CFTV_INATIVA
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 99
 shutdown
 exit

interface range FastEthernet0/20 - 24
 description RESERVA_GERAL_INATIVA
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 99
 shutdown
 exit

interface GigabitEthernet0/2
 description RESERVA_UPLINK_INATIVA
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 99
 shutdown
 exit

! --- 6. Interface de Gerencia (SVI VLAN 99) e Gateway ---
interface Vlan99
 description GERENCIA_SW_ANAFASHION
 ip address 192.168.99.2 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
 exit

ip default-gateway 192.168.99.1

! --- 7. Salvar Configuracao ---
end
write memory
